title: The Ugly Duckling
description: A young bird who never seems to fit in leaves the farmyard behind and survives a long winter before discovering what he was becoming all along.
catalogueBlurb: A lonely young bird crosses the seasons and discovers who he really is.

cover.alt: Vilhelm Pedersen's historic illustration for The Ugly Duckling.

editions.label: Story House Edition
editions.author: Hans Christian Andersen, retold by Quill

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on Hans Christian Andersen's public-domain 1843 tale
text.notes: Hans Christian Andersen's underlying 1843 story is public domain. This wording is an original child-friendly Unicorn Valley retelling.

illustrations.notes: The selected Vilhelm Pedersen source files are identified as public domain on Wikimedia Commons. Pedersen died in 1859.

rights.curatorNotes: Split into six short reader sections following the story's natural seasonal and location changes. Existing Vilhelm Pedersen artwork is preserved as Classic Illustrations; R6.5-WP19SH1.4.3 adds a separate generated Modern Illustrations set focused on the protagonist's transformation across the seasons.
